## October 16, 2026

## RBI approves amalgamation of Indian branches of Emirates NBD Bank P.J.S.C.

## with RBL Bank Limited

The Reserve Bank of India has sanctioned the <u>Scheme of Amalgamation</u> of Indian branches of Emirates NBD Bank P.J.S.C. (Transferor Bank) with RBL Bank Limited (Transferee Bank). The Scheme has been sanctioned in exercise of the powers contained in sub-section (4) of Section 44A of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949. The effective date of the amalgamation shall be December 01, 2026. All the Indian branches of Emirates NBD Bank P.J.S.C. will function as branches of RBL Bank Limited with effect from December 01, 2026.
